items.title: Identifying the Right Threat Under Pressure 👀
items.description:
Identifying the Right Threat Under Pressure 👀

SWAT Commander Mike Nielson explains how officers train for scenarios involving both threats and innocent people. Officers must enter the room, quickly evaluate what is happening, and respond only to the individual who presents a danger.
